verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents its own threshold-based alerts on Cost, Errors and Feedback Score, where Feedback Score covers eval-score drops via online evaluators. Errors alerts can be refined with a filter builder, and alerts route natively to Slack and PagerDuty (plus Dynatrace or any webhook). Email notification is never documented, so the story's channel set is only partly covered. missing for 10: documented email alert delivery, explicit cost-spike or anomaly detection beyond static thresholds, an explicit link between online-eval scores and the Feedback Score alert metric, independent or hands-on corroboration of alerting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set alerts on error rates, cost spikes, or eval-score drops and get notified in Slack, PagerDuty, or email

citations.quote: LangSmith provides threshold-based alerting on the following metrics: Run Count, Cost, Errors, Feedback Score, Latency
Alerts can route to Slack, PagerDuty, Dynatrace, or any HTTP endpoint via webhook.
for Errors and Latency, you can use the filter builder to stack conditions on fields such as Status, Run Type, Tag, and Error.
